title: Usage Fingerprint Cost Lens & Rate-Card Export Flow
creator: Marina Lopez
description: Goal: design a compact, scannable 'Cost Lens' that surfaces token-level cost attributions across dimensions (model variant, prompt type, route, customer tag) plus a rate-card export flow that maps those attributions to pricing tiers and CSV exports for finance. Scope includes: the primary Cost Lens dashboard panel (pivot + sparkline + hotspot breakdown), an inline token-attribution inspector, an export modal (CSV & JSON Line export with configurable granularity), and a rate-card mapping UI for ops to bind SKU/pricing tiers to cost buckets. Non-goals: building the backend attribution engine or pricing computation logic (engineering will provide endpoints), replacing full Billing UI. Acceptance criteria: (1) clickable token-level attribution drill with latency/cost columns; (2) pivotable dimensions and saved views; (3) export modal that supports per-request, per-session, and aggregated CSV formats; (4) rate-card editor that validates tier mappings and shows projected monthly spend estimates; (5) accessibility and mobile-responsive breakpoints for the primary lens panel.
activity: 2026-03-01 — Kickoff: scoped objectives with PM and product. Agreed to prioritize export formats that finance needs (line-item CSV) and a condensed pivoted Cost Lens for console home.

2026-03-02 — Low-fi sketches completed. Two patterns considered: (A) compact pivot table with sparklines and flyout inspector, (B) full-width graph-first view with stacked cost bands. PM prefers compact for dashboard density.

2026-03-03 — Figma prototype v0.1 created: includes pivot controls, sample token-attribution flyout, and export modal mock. Linked to design review. Engineering (Rohit Patel) flagged potential payload size concerns for per-token export; recommended server-side aggregations and pagination for export API.

2026-03-04 — Design review notes: include explicit privacy note that raw prompt text will not be exported unless customer opts in; add sampling toggle for large datasets; add clear mapping from cost lines to rate-card SKU names.

2026-03-05 — PM feedback: add 'saved view' affordance and 'compare' mode for two rate-card revisions. Assigned follow-ups: finalize microcopy for export modal, produce QA checklist, and deliver Handoff Figma file to Eng.
notes_for_engineering: Design expects endpoints: /costlens/summary (pivoted), /costlens/drill (token-attribution paginated), /costlens/export (CSV/JSONL with server-side aggregation and sampling). Export must support masking of prompts by default. Provide sample payloads for QA.
design_decisions: Chose pivot-table-first pattern to maximize density and allow rapid scanning. Token-level inspector implemented as flyout to avoid full-page navigations. Rate-card editor is lightweight: map tags->SKU->price per 1k tokens with preview of monthly spend. Trade-offs: sampling reduces fidelity for very high-volume exports but keeps UX responsive; opted for server-side aggregation to avoid shipping huge payloads to client.
next_steps: Finalize Figma (v0.2) with approved microcopy; run 3 quick usability sessions with 5 internal users (finance, platform, SRE); prepare engineering handoff ticket with API contract and fixtures; schedule a checklist-based security review for export privacy options.
